simple.meaning: אֹיֵב (ʼôyêb) is a Hebrew action word meaning “hating ; an adversary.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 284 times in Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 4 more, beginning at Genesis 22:17. The surrounding contexts include family.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אֹיֵב (H341) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: אֹיֵב (ʼôyêb) / H341 is traced through Genesis 22:17, Genesis 49:8, Exodus 15:6, Exodus 15:9 with source-language evidence and verse context.
